commands.prepare_native_dependencies:
if ! xcrun -sdk macosx metal --version; then
  xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain
fi
python3 Scripts/verify-corresponding-source.py DependencySources
python3 Scripts/install-ci-native-sdk.py
commands.prepare_packet_fixture:
export ILLIQUID_PACKET_OWNERSHIP_FIXTURE="$RUNNER_TEMP/packet-ownership.mp4"
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y \
  -f lavfi -i 'testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=24' \
  -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000' -t 3 \
  -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -c:a aac "$ILLIQUID_PACKET_OWNERSHIP_FIXTURE"

limits: This is the unfiltered root-package release suite and a linked app build, separate from the isolated source-browser component checks.
Swift Testing totals are reported exactly as printed. Explicit skips and fixture-dependent early returns mean these totals do not prove every generated-media assertion executed.

The generated codec, seek, audio, bitmap and thumbnail fixture qualification matrix was not enabled by this workflow. Many tests in NativePlaybackFixtureIntegrationTests return immediately without ILLIQUID_NATIVE_FIXTURE_DIR; its strict manifest check requires ILLIQUID_NATIVE_REQUIRE_FIXTURES=1.

The log explicitly records three optional long native playback cases and the real-window glass font qualification as NOT RUN. Efficiency observations, conversion-only timing and real-media subtitle opt-ins also have explicit skipped entries.
The command serializes test cases with --no-parallel; concurrency exercised inside individual tests remains active.
This run does not establish signed app packaging, installation, sustained playback qualification or user-visible UI performance.
